quarterly_data.signal: Mistral introduced Voxtral 3, a family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models plus a voice agent SDK (listening, reasoning, tool calling and speaking in one real-time pipeline), available today through Mistral's EU-hosted API or for self-deployment: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 (transcription in 50 languages incl. the 24 official EU languages, diarization, context biasing), a 4B-parameter Mini transcription variant priced at $0.0035/min, Voxtral Realtime Transcribe 3 (sub-500ms latency in over 35 languages), Voxtral Mini TTS 3 (35+ languages, 50+ dialects) and Pro Voice adaptation from 30 minutes of audio. Mistral claims state-of-the-art results that outperform Whisper, Scribe v2 and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (company claim).
quarterly_data.figure: 50 languages; Mini 4B parameters at $0.0035/min; sub-500ms realtime latency
